tei:div.tei:p: he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo//

dung brda gnyis dang mkhar rngas bskul te/ tshogs khang du 'tshogs pa thams cad 'dus te/ dge skos kyi gdong gral gzhung du gral yig gdong gral g.yas pa'i mgo nas klog rim bzhin gral du bzhugs/ de nas gdong gral g.yon par dbu bzhugs nas rim par dang*/ mchod gral bsgrig zin pa dbu mdzad nas bskul te tshig bdun sogs la 'jug bdag bskyed kyi mchod rol la ḍa/ dbang gi mchod rol la ḍa med/ sa lha'i mchod pa byin brlabs la ḍa yod/ de min par mchod rol rnams la ḍa med/ sa lha'i gtor ma gshegs te gnang ba byin par sogs dus mchod pa bsdu/ gtor ma gser skyems phyir dor/ sil rol rang ba'i skabs mchod dpon gyi rgyal tshab kyi rdo dril zhus pa dang mnyam du las slob bzhengs te/ mdun gral g.yon pa'i rgyab nas phebs te dkyil 'khor mdun zhal dkyil 'khor la phyogs par bzhugs pa dang bstun rol mo kha phye/ zhwa mi mnab/ dbang phur dal dbus su bkod/ hūm̐/ pad+ma takrid sogs bdun/ de nas slob dpon skor ba mi dgos/ byang shar dal bu'i phebs te thams cad kyi rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sa gnon rgyas/ oṃ swā bha wa sogs/ slob dpon gyi rdo dril bzhag las rdor gyi steng phur dang tho ba phyag tu phul/ de nas phur gdab sogs bya/ bsam lhun btang zhor rgyal tho la phebs dus gdong gral g.yon pa'i mjug nas g.yas bskor kyi sngon la phebs nas/ de nas slob dpon rgyal tshab bcas de nas gzan phrag khyer phebs/ mchod gral sogs mi phebs/ bzhugs te rim gro gsung*/ tho 'dzug tu bsdu rgya med/ dzaḥhūm̐ sogs la rgya yod/ de nas sgo khang du phebs dus mchod dpon nas dam sri mnan pa grub nas dong nang du bcug gser skyems la/ thang gnyis pa la g.yab dar gcig gnyis pa la gcig bram la/ gser skyems gdangs chen tshig 4 phyi ma rnams la rta/ 'don mtshams gsum la phud re lding ka rar phul/ dam sri mnan pa la dgug gzhug lan gcig la g.yab dar lan gnyis/

dur khrod bgegs kyi tshogs 'jom dus phur ba gdab tshul dang*/ mnan dong khar thun brab/ ar+ya a tsa la saugs la g.yab dar rdo rje rgya gram re lan 13 bya/ de nas mnan dong khar bro ra zlum po bcas lag g.yas steng mar byas te mdzub mo sbrel te bro brdung*/ gnyis pa bro ra gru bzhi pad skor rgyas lag pa g.yon steng ma byas te gong mo sbrel/ phyi ma gnyis la rigs 'gre/ bro la bskor ba mi dgos/ de nas bskor ba zhor gral gshegs te kha yar dkyu nas sgo byang btags/ 'di la tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra med/ tshogs pa rnams rang gral du phebs/ zhwa phud/ tshogs pa rnams rang gral du/ slob dpon yar lam sngags chas su zhugs/ ja btang*/ ma tram̐ bsgral ba'i/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta sogs dus slob dpon dkyil 'khor g.yas phyogs nas mdun phebs te khri'ur bzhugs/ 2 lcags kyu'i rgya bcas ma tram ma tram̐ ka ru sogs lan/ bden stobs g.yab dar sngags rol zhabs/ bzhag rol/ oṃ ma hā shrī sogs 'jam 'don/ thams cad kyis kha ṭaṃ rgyas gzugs phung hrul zhig sogs brjod/ de nas slob dpon sogs rab bsdus kyi/ sum bha ni zhwa dang bcas dkyil 'khor mthar bro ra bsgal te/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas sogs bro brdung*/ ya ma dam sri mthar zhwa phud/ rang gral du bzhugs/ slob dpon slar yang rdo dril bcas dal mdun 'khod de khur tshur dpung mgor bsnol te bzhugs/ tshogs pa byings nas rgya bcas/ bh+rum̐ dz+nyā na sogs brjod mthar dbye rgya/ dkyil 'khor sgo shag gi sogs brjod/ de nas byang shar du phebs/ hūm̐ sogs lan re la dkyil 'khor bsing 'gros/ bskor ba bsdu na lan gsum/ de 'dra tshar gsum zin phral slob dpon byang shar nas dal bus phebs/ zhal shar du phyogs par bzhed/ rngam rol bcas bdag nyid las kyi nas a ta'i bar brjod/ mthar zil rol mo nas slob dpon phar byon nas zhwa chos phud/ bzhag rol/ de nas slob dpon dang las rdor slob dpon gyi gsang thig gdab/

zhwa med/ gnyis pa rgyan 'god pa hūm̐/ 'phrul bzhad sogs skabs dal mdun gdan kheb khar gtso dgu'i thod rten/ khro bcu'i phur pa gdan can/ bdug khrab byug pa'i rdzas sogs dkyil 'khor rgyan chas thams cad 'du bya/ cho ga tshig bdun/ 3 kun bzang bde stong*/ brgyud 'debs/ rdo rje slob dpon gdangs ma tshar gcig sems can bde dang*/ bdag bskyed nyer bsdu ltar bar sa chog bzhin/ sdom brtson dam pa'i ja mchod/ chab btang nas grol/ de nas grwa mang rang gral nas bzhengs/ zhwa bzhes/ rdor dril dang rol thog mchod rol bya/ rgya gling pas sna drangs/ spos phor/ rdo rje slob dpon dri spos re bsnams/ rgyal tshab thod sku dang sman gyi pho brang*/ de nas rim bzhin/ gtso dgu'i thod rten gnyis re grwa ba re res khur/ phur pa bcu sogs/ sgrub chas thams cad thog nas g.yas bskor gsum la 'jam rol/ slob dpon dal mdun bzhengs/ sngags tshar re bzhin rol mo re bya/ rgyal tshab las rdor gnyis ka zhwa bcas bskor ba re bcas bkod/ gnyis pa phur pa rnams sogs/ drag sngags so lnga byings bcas lan 3 la dang po gu gul bdug gnyis pa yungs kar/ gsum pa rak+ta byugs nas/ oṃ badz+ra ka ya sogs/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i rgya/ ki la ya hūṃ zhes/ phur gdan bcu sogs/ rdo ra'i steng du bkod/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings skye med sogs yo ga dur khrod gzhal yas sogs/ ma ṭaṃ khog pa dur khrod brgyad du bkod/ 'di skabs mgo lho nub yin/ de'i go rim ltar dgos/ nam mkha' mdzod sogs rgya dang bcas/ hūm̐/ snang srid 'khor 'das gdod ma nas sogs lag gnyis 'khyud rgya dpung mgo bsnol yo ga spyi gdangs chung ba/ rdor dril med/ pra we sha phaṭa/ dbye rgya/ hūm̐/ khams gsum sogs thal mo sbyar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu sogs dril bu bsil te skur rten/ pad bskor dang 'khyud rgya/ ja btang chab bsil/ sku zhabs gdan khar bzhugs/ byang bu la so so'i sku dang

sogs/ slob dpon sngar bum pa phur pa sogs bkod pa'i mdun gdan la bzhugs/ las rdor gyis gu gul/ gtso bum/ bum pa dgu/ gtso phur phur pa dgu dbang mo nyer brgyad kyi phur pa rnams la yungs kar brab/ rak+ta byugs/ bdug pa dang lhan cig dbu mdzad nas/ badz+ra kro dha sogs dpal dgu'i sngags re re bzhin tshar gsum re bzhin rol mo re re/ de nas slob dpon bzhengs/ dbu zhwa rdor dril spos rengs 'dzin nas gzhung gral mjug bzhengs/ tshogs pa thams cad bzhengs/ zhwa gyon/ zla gam phud/ rdor dril dang rol cha rnams bzung nas/ rol dril skabs las rdor gyis gtso bum dang*/ gtso phur slob dpon la phul/ des rgyal tshab la gtad pas las rdor dang gnyis kas zhwa gyon bzhin g.yas bskor du rang gnas ma 'chor bar bkod do/ hūm̐/ dbus nas sogs/ bum pa phur pa thams cad zhal gtso bo la phyogs/ gtso bo'i zhal shar phyogs dkyu ba yin/ 'jam rol tshe rgyal tshab pas gtso bum dang phur pa gdan la bkod/ oṃ badz+ra sarba yak+ṣa sa ma ya sogs/ dbang mo rnams khyams kyi shar stod nas phur gdan la bkod/ sgo ma bzhi phyir bstan/ ja btang*/ lho nub ma sa grol/ ༈ dngos grub len chog la dung chos nang du chang dang rak+ta sbyar ba mjug phyir bstan pa sngags g.yas dang*/ mo thod khar bran thur bzhag pa g.yon du bkod/ hūm̐ gsum sogs dus bran thur gyis rak+ta lan gsum phyar/ zhi ba dang dpal dgu'i snying po lan gsum bzlas mthar/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi lan gsum las mi dgos/ de dus slob dpon gyi lan gsum gyis mo thod du rak+ta rdzogs par phul/ yang badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa'i dus slob dpon bdud rtsi las/ las rdor gyi bran thur gang blang ba gtor ma la bran/ dkyil 'khor mdun gyi sman thod la thig re blug las rdor gyi dkyil 'khor sman thod/ slob dpon gyi bzed zhal gyi thod pa 'degs la/ hūm̐/ rang byung gdod nas sogs rdor dril bcas gdangs las byang bzhin gyi mthar/

hūm̐/ dam tshig thig le sogs yang sbrel mar btang*/ las rdor dkyil 'khor gyi bdud rtsi bran thur gang bzed zhal gyi rak+ta blug de rgyal tshab pas slob dpon la phul gnas gsum thig le bya/ phyir gnang nas 'dus pa thams cad la thig le re bya/ hūm̐/ dur khrod sogs/ yo ga mthar/ che mchog sngags dbyangs lan gsum nas rol mo ring*/ rdzas rnams 'god tshar bstun rol mo dbye/ snang grags sogs kyis grol/ gral gzhan gnyis dang gzhung gral gnyis/ so sor steng shod du zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg bya'o// sbyin sreg gi dang po me gso ba la/ dgang glug kho nas mar khu blug blug gzar mi dgos/ 'das ma 'das kyi gtor ma 2 dang*/ tam bu la blug gzar gyis phul dgos/ ༄༅/ ho/ mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon bde bar gshegs pa'i sa bcu lam lnga'i yon tan gyi bar chad nyer 'tshe mi mthun pa'i phyogs ngan pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sa dang lam gyi rim pa lhun grub snang ba bzhi'i nyams dang rtogs pa ye shes yon tan thams cad yongs su 'phel zhing rgyas nas gzhan don du phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro don gdul bya sku tshe dang bsod nams sogs rgyas pa dang*/ rtogs pa'i rig 'dzin snang ba bzhi'i rtogs par rang dbang bsgyur nas thugs rje gzhan don du khams gsum skye dgu'i bla yid dbang du 'du ba dang*/ sa dang lam gyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad brlag pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rgya chen po'i go 'phang la mnga' brnyes par mdzad du gsol/// /
